decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, non-contradictory claims regarding awards received by Knut Korsæth. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states he received the 'Commander of the Order of St. Olav' (supported by D1S3 and D1S19). Document 2 (D2) explicitly states he was bestowed the 'Commander of the Legion of Honour' (supported by D2S2). As different artists/people can legitimately receive multiple distinct awards, and the prompt instructs to keep supported alternate referents rather than selecting a single winner, both answers are valid and should be included.
